text:
ITEM 1 | Flaky pale-orange fish fillet pieces with browned, crisp edges and a creamy-looking light sauce, dotted with small green herb bits and corn kernels; sits on the left third of the plate, roughly 9 x 7 cm footprint, about 2.5 cm thick at its thickest, with a fork-flaked, layered texture | 150
ITEM 2 | Reddish-brown cooked grain (brown/red rice or similar whole grain) with separate, slightly sticky-looking individual grains, matte surface, mounded in the center-left under the fish, roughly 8 x 6 cm footprint and about 2 cm high | 120
ITEM 3 | Bright green whole green beans, slender, around 8-10 cm long, glossy, lightly cooked with a firm snap, arranged in a loose bundle at top-center, about 6 x 5 cm footprint, 1 cm high | 50
ITEM 4 | Mixed salad greens: dark burgundy-red leaves and bright green curly and flat leaves, crisp, fresh, slightly wet-looking, piled on the right side, about 9 x 7 cm footprint and 2 cm high | 45
ITEM 5 | Spinach-like dark green leaves, flat and smooth, scattered beneath the rice at lower center, about 6 x 4 cm, thin | 15
ITEM 6 | Segments of orange (mandarin-type) fruit, bright orange with translucent juicy flesh, two or three small pieces near the salad, about 3 x 3 cm each | 15
ITEM 7 | Small green herb sprigs and fine chopped herb flecks scattered over the fish, bright green, soft and fresh, about 3 cm across total | 3
